note: Level 1, both label levels read (.sav sha256s match the batch_644-653 records). Code derivation: item IS the source column name (learn1-3 in both S1c and S2c; script maps learn{i}->learn{i}), so exempt from Step 5b and no verification files. PER-STUDY VARIANTS: live cov_study 4 = S1c (796 ids, 2388 rows, itemcov_recoded=0), 7 = S2c (793 ids, 2379 rows, itemcov_recoded=1). All three variable labels differ between studies only in the organization named (S1c: 'MCM Consulting'; S2c: 'XYZ Organization'), so following the batch_644-653 convention item_text carries both verbatim labels prefixed 'Study S1c (cov_study = 4): ' / 'Study S2c (cov_study = 7): ' joined by ' | ' (prefixes and separator are IRW's; wording after each prefix is the variable label verbatim, including curly apostrophes and S1c learn3's source typo 'MCM’s Consulting’s', kept uncorrected). OPTIONS: S1c value labels 1='1 - not at all', 2..6 = bare digits, 7='7 - very much'; S2c's run the other way (1='1 - very much' ... 7='7 - not at all') and the script rewrote S2c as 8-resp. Route 9, all 6 study x item count vectors (resp 1..7): S1c learn1 76/61/68/103/177/157/154, learn2 90/70/73/113/155/143/152, learn3 87/49/70/95/147/156/192 source = live exactly; S2c learn1 source 107/115/156/117/99/79/120 -> live 120/79/99/117/156/115/107, learn2 84/105/138/121/106/93/146 -> 146/93/106/121/138/105/84, learn3 129/129/142/106/87/75/125 -> 125/75/87/106/142/129/129 (each an exact reversal). Direction cross-check on the raw S2c file: learndich ('If given the chance, would you choose to learn more about XYZ Organization?' 1=Yes, 2=No) -> raw learn-mean 2.734 for Yes vs 5.546 for No, so S2c's printed 1 = very much is correct and the recode is right; raw learn-mean correlates +0.766 with raw fit-mean (1 = Strongly agree) in S2c and -0.115 in S1c (weak but correctly signed); growth condition more interested in both (S1c raw 5.055 growth vs 4.237 fixed on 1 = not at all; S2c raw 3.580 vs 4.322 on 1 = very much). So live resp 1 = not at all, 7 = very much in both studies; option_text ships those anchors with the '1 - '/'7 - ' prefixes stripped (they would be wrong for the recoded S2c rows); resp 2-6 carry only their own digit in both sources and are left blank. No instructions text in either .sav; left blank. The script docstring says S1c targeted XYZ Organization, but S1c's labels name MCM Consulting; the labels were followed. Rights: study-authored items, no stated restriction located (silence = permission).
public_note: Items learn1-3 named a different target organization in the two pooled studies (MCM Consulting in Study S1c, cov_study = 4; XYZ Organization in Study S2c, cov_study = 7), so item_text gives both wordings labelled by study; responses are coded 1 = not at all to 7 = very much in both studies, Study S2c having been reverse-recoded from its printed order (itemcov_recoded = 1).
